_howTo: To add something new, copy one item below, give it a new id, title and description, and set added to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD). It shows as New for newDays days. See ADDING.md.

items.title: Quick reset
items.description: One minute of double sighs. For when it's all too much, right now.

items.title: Slow it down
items.description: Three minutes of breathing out longer than you breathe in.

items.title: Steady box
items.description: Five minutes of the same simple rhythm. Predictable, nothing changes.

items.title: Even breathing
items.description: Ten minutes at about six breaths a minute.

items.title: Winding down
items.description: Five minutes of 4-7-8 breathing before bed.

items.title: Quiet room
items.description: Steady brown noise that takes the edge off sharp sounds. Good with earbuds in a busy place.

items.title: Rain room
items.description: Soft rain with a low, steady base.

items.title: Low tide
items.description: Slow waves and a warm hum. For resting when you have nothing left.

items.title: Soft focus
items.description: Light noise and a quiet hum to work or read with.
